sample_values: V1 was traveling northbound on a two lane non-divided roadway when the frontal plane of V1 struck the left plane of V2. V1 continued northbound and the frontal plane of V1 struck the rear plane of V3.  V1 deflected left after impact to V3 and the front plane of V1 struck the front plane of V4 which was parked facing south on the west edge of the road. V1 left then contacted V4 front.  Vehicles 2, 3, and 4 were all legally parked and unoccupied.
